column3: MT 89:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1 and transliterates “a poem” as “A Maskil”; the plural “covenant loyalties” is rendered “the lovingkindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the heavens—You establish Your faithfulness in them” is rendered “In the heavens You will establish Your faithfulness.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB sets verses 3–4 as God's words.
Close to the Hebrew; “offspring” is rendered “seed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the clouds” is rendered “the skies,” and “sons of gods” as “sons of the mighty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they go to meet Your face” is rendered “go before You,” and “faithfulness” as “truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “then” is rendered “Once,” and “I have placed help on a warrior” as “I have given help to one who is mighty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “reliable” is rendered “confirmed.”
